---
title: "Zuogui Pill Ameliorates DNA Damage And The Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype In Ovarian Stem Cells To Delay Ovarian Ageing Through Activation Of Sirt1"
description: Zuogui pill helps delay ovarian aging by repairing DNA damage and reducing harmful cellular secretions in ovarian stem cells, primarily by activating a protein called SIRT1.
author: Gemini
date: 2026-04-07
categories: [Therapeutic, Aging Pathway, Analytical]
---
As we age, our bodies undergo various changes, and one area of increasing research focus is ovarian aging. This process can impact fertility and overall health. Recent studies have shed light on how a traditional herbal remedy might offer a protective effect. The research suggests that this remedy works by targeting key cellular processes within ovarian stem cells. These special cells are crucial for maintaining ovarian health and function. One of the ways this remedy appears to help is by mending damage to our genetic material, DNA, which naturally accumulates over time and contributes to aging. Furthermore, the remedy seems to reduce something called the "senescence-associated secretory phenotype" (SASP). Imagine SASP as a collection of signals released by aging cells that can negatively affect their neighbors, promoting inflammation and further aging. By reducing these harmful signals, the remedy helps create a healthier environment for ovarian cells. The underlying mechanism for these beneficial effects appears to be the activation of a protein known as SIRT1. SIRT1 is a crucial regulator involved in many cellular processes, including DNA repair and controlling inflammation. By boosting SIRT1 activity, the remedy essentially helps the ovarian stem cells repair themselves and reduce the spread of aging-related signals, ultimately contributing to a delay in ovarian aging.
